Added stage-specific hard limits and stop thresholds with 5 CPU / 10 wall seconds reserved in each stage; checks observed and upper costs without borrowing allocations.
Required the complete single-attempt authorization binding to exact spec bytes, stage, coordinator directive, resource/execution flags, and stage limits before runtime sampling.
Validated source/orchestration path descriptors and exact predecessor state descriptors, then carried observed and bounded costs into the cumulative round ledger.
Preserved fresh-PID, pre-fork zero RUSAGE_CHILDREN, descendant wait4, owned process-group stop (-15 / raw 15), dynamic project capacity, reap, and footer accounting.
Added structural stage worker completion checks for CHECKS, DIAGNOSTIC, and AUDIT without recomputing scientific metrics.
Froze the control output schema for CHECKS; exact per-stage authorization, resources, and spec remain mandatory.
